public.text: Vendor claims are identified as a testing target, but there is no requirement for publication of test scope, supported options, exceptions, versions, or expiry of certification.
public.suggestedRevision: Require a standard conformance statement identifying component, actor role, supported services, profiles, versions, options, test environment, results, limitations, certification authority, issue date, and validity period.
